A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GPTQ–Babai research. Their text, equations, figures, tables and appendices support reliable comparison despite extensive reformatting and appendix renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original Qwen3 quantization evaluations, quantization-order experiments in Table 2, and CUDA performance measurements in Figures 4–5.

after.justification: v3 retains these original results and adds Llama evaluations in Tables 11–16. It explicitly identifies the externally sourced comparator scores in Table 16.

M1.justification: The min-pivot ordering, SSQR scale adjustment and overflow handling, HPTQ/HRTN procedures, and CUDA kernel design are retained. Expanded pseudocode annotations do not change algorithmic steps.

E1.justification: Both versions use FineWeb-Edu calibration, WikiText-2/C4 perplexity, and the same downstream task set. Qwen3 HellaSwag results disappear, but HellaSwag remains in the added Llama evaluations. The model-family expansion changes experimental configurations rather than datasets or task requirements.

E2.justification: v3 Table 16 adds substantive comparisons against AQLM, QuIP# and QTIP on Llama-2-7B, beyond v2's GPTQ/RTN/HRTN comparisons. These methods participate through explicitly literature-sourced scores; the PDF does not establish fresh comparator runs.

E3.justification: v3 adds evaluations of Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-2-7B, reports both HellaSwag accuracy and normalized accuracy, and introduces the literature-based comparison in Table 16. Existing Qwen3 calibration, grouping and quantization-order settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The quantization-order analysis in Table 2 and kernel sweeps across bitwidths, outlier rates and batch sizes in Figures 4–5 are retained. The added Llama benchmark tables introduce no distinct ablation, robustness test or error analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report fixed-seed calibration sampling and averaging random-order results over 100 runs. v3 adds no new repeated-run information, confidence intervals, significance tests or uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: v3 adds Llama results in Tables 11–16; for example, Table 12 reports WikiText-2 perplexity of 7.84 for HPTQ versus 9.44 for GPTQ at 3.125 bits. Retained Qwen3 values are unchanged, while its HellaSwag entries are removed. New Table 14 prints an apparent PiQA typo, 7497, whose intended value is unclear.

T1.justification: v3 corrects an intermediate denominator in Theorem 2 from a cross inner product to the squared norm of n_j2. Equation 62 now invokes Lemma 7 instead of independence. The theorem statements, error guarantees and principal appendix proofs otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: Both versions claim GPTQ–Babai equivalence, no-clipping error guarantees, improved quantization through SSQR/HPTQ, and efficient CUDA inference. The additional evidence and context do not redefine these central contributions.

C2.justification: v3 Section 6 newly argues that small-group MXFP4/NVFP4 formats make no-clipping analysis practically relevant. Section E.5 also interprets the new comparisons as showing scalar quantization approaching vector-quantizer accuracy. Existing mechanism explanations and applicability boundaries are largely retained.

D1.justification: v3 adds a source-code link in the abstract and a reproducibility statement describing supplementary code and environment/reproduction instructions. v2 provides no corresponding code-access information. Existing calibration and kernel implementation details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 credits Choi et al. (2017) for earlier Huffman-based compression, adds positioning against AQLM/QuIP#/QTIP, and cites recent FP4 research. These are limited extensions; the main related-work discussion and GPTQ novelty positioning remain intact.

P1.justification: v3 polishes wording, expands comments in Algorithms 1–3, replaces the front contents with appendix contents, and divides the conclusion into Summary and Future Work. Ethics, reproducibility and LLM-use statements are added, while the main narrative and proof organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: The ICLR formatting changes typography and placement throughout. Algorithms 1–2 become separate displays, Table 1 moves into Section 4.1, six new result tables appear, and the Qwen3 HellaSwag table/column disappear. Existing performance plots are reused with changed sizing and placement.

improvement.justification: The added Llama evaluations reduce reliance on one model family, while modern comparator results and code-access information improve assessability. Local proof corrections also improve correctness. These gains outweigh the loss of Qwen3 HellaSwag results and the apparent Table 14 typo, but literature-sourced comparisons at differing bitwidths limit the strength of the additional evidence.
